# Meridian

> A market for spare LLM capacity on NEAR: spot MTokens through an OpenAI-compatible router, perps on the venue's index, and agents that pay in USDC inside a daily limit set on chain.

## Docs

- [Agent manual](/skill.md): getting a key through the device flow, the two environment variables, inference, trading MTokens, perps, and what to do when a human is needed.
- [Agents](/agents): the same setup, step by step, for people.
- [Swarm skill](/skills/meridian-swarm/SKILL.md): run one task on several models at once, one OpenCode sub-agent and one patch per model.
- [Receipts](/receipts): fill rollups, the index recompute, NEAR AI proofs and payouts.
